description: This Java class 'DOMRomUnmarshaller' is responsible for parsing and unmarshalling XML definitions related to ROM configurations and data structures used in the RomRaider project. It processes XML nodes representing ROMs, tables, scales, and other related entities to produce Java objects representing the ROM data.

classes.name: DOMRomUnmarshaller
classes.description: A utility class for unmarshalling ROM-related XML data into Java objects, supporting inheritance, scale parsing, and table configuration.

methods.name: unmarshallXMLDefinition
methods.description: Main entry point to parse the root XML node for ROMs and scales, returning the matched Rom object.

methods.name: foundMatch
methods.description: Checks whether the given RomID matches the content of the ROM file bytes, supporting hex string and string ID matching.

methods.name: unmarshallRom
methods.description: Constructs a Rom object from the XML node, parsing child nodes such as tables andROMID.

methods.name: unmarshallRomID
methods.description: Parses a RomID from the XML node, extracting identifiers and metadata.

methods.name: getBaseRom
methods.description: Retrieves a base Rom object for inheritance, based on the XML ID.

methods.name: unmarshallScale
methods.description: Creates or clones a Scale object from the XML node.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Test method to verify the foundMatch method functionality.
